REQUIREMENTS
1. JavaScript programming skills, specifically with JavaScript frameworks and libraries.
2. Knowledge of agile development processes and TDD /BDD workflows.
3. Experience with designing and implementing REST APIs
4. Experience with NoSQL and SQL databases.
5. Experience with HTML5/CSS3, and front-end frameworks (like Twitter Bootstrap)
6. Experience with deployment to cloud infrastructure environments.
7. Knowledge of design patterns, algorithms, love for elegant designs, prototyping, and refactoring existing features.

EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS
• Bachelor’s Degree in computer science or equivalent degree;
• Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience
